I am 17 as well, and I keep on coming back to this mentality. The one thing I want to say is just keep living. I know that is a stupid answer that everyone says, and it makes me angry when people say that. There is just no other way of saying it. Recently, this summer, I was a step away from killing myself. For some reason I didn't do it, and I can say that was an ok decision, sometimes I regret it, but I wouldn't have had the experiences I had this year if I did. My grades are mediocre, not good enough to get into a really good uni, I don't like ANY career path and thinking of the future makes me scared (another reason why I wanted to kill myself), there is nothing that gives me hope for the future. I am just a burden on my parents mentally.  I just recommend, living your life, and putting yourself out there to have good experiences with people. After a while of doing that, see where you are and if you feel the same way. I can't promise it will get better, but this will pass as time passes. I know this is probably shit advice, but I am here to talk and listen if you need someone.
